text: …なんだ　＊じゃ　ないじゃん

patterns.name: 〜ではない
patterns.explanation: じゃない after a name or thing says 'is not'. It is the everyday spoken form of ではない. ＊じゃ　ない = 'it is not ＊'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃん at the end is a slangy short form of じゃないか and means 'hey, look, it's so!', pointing out something the listener should see too. ないじゃん = 'it isn't, is it!'.
